title: PostgreSQL: per-instance HLC node_id and IPNS single-writer
description: Derive HLC node_id from instance UUID stored in PostgreSQL (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING at startup to claim a UUID). Multiple transit instances each get a distinct node_id even with a shared signing key. IPNS publisher: use pg_try_advisory_lock(IPNS_LOCK_ID) to elect a single publisher; others skip.
